title: Genesys VTT
description: Genesys VTT 0.0.15A QA: first Character Sheet UX and information-hierarchy pass. Core characteristics and vital combat stats are promoted to a compact dashboard; encounter state, conditions, combat/equipment, skills, criticals, and profile controls are reorganized for normal play; development regression surfaces are retained under Advanced / QA Tools. Preserves the verified 0.0.14 Rule Engine, 0.0.146 Extra Activation UX, and 0.0.147 Narrative Results Assistant.
